presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, use Load ROM to choose your own supported Beetle Adventure Racing USA ROM. The launcher validates and imports it. This upstream alpha is offered through Preview; its Linux build is known to crash during boot and is not offered by this declaration. Default imported ROM, settings, saves, cheats, bindings, HUD choices and hang reports live in LocalAppData/beetle-adventure-racing-recomp, outside Portcove backups. Only the executable-folder bar_ui_trace.log diagnostic is declared. Keep portable.txt absent and use an external registration for portable/custom storage or a current-folder fallback. Existing external copies keep their files and runtime owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations.
